title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

We’re looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager (equivalent to a technical account manager) to manage our rapidly growing enterprise customer base across all industries. As a Sr. CSM, you’ll work closely with sales, implementation, engineering and product while also working with a variety of customer stakeholders. You will advise customers on how to transform the way they manage B2B purchasing across their business, creating immediate value and efficiency for employees through product adoption and enablement.

This role is ideal for you if you enjoy being a product expert, creative problem solving, and want to work with a world-class team and customers such as Coinbase, Snowflake, Toast, Northwestern Mutual, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks, Miro, and many more.

YOU WILL

- Identify champions and build relationships with key business stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT/Security, and Privacy/Compliance teams.

- Maintain high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction with a focus on customer adoption and loyalty.

- Manage customer health and hedge account risks based on data-driven adoption metrics.

- Partner closely with product and engineering to translate business needs and requirements into new solutions for customers, while skillfully managing customer expectations.

- Train and empower customers to be product specialists to become increasingly self-sufficient for their organization.

- Partner with the renewals team to achieve target GRR.

- Responsible for post implementation technical health of the client and perform hands on support in product adoption, and enablement.

- Continuously improve Customer Success assets and processes. We’re an early-stage company, we want people who are excited to build and motivated to up-level the status quo!

QUALIFICATIONS

- 8+ years of relevant work experience working in customer-facing customer success, technical account management or strategic consulting organization. B2B SaaS experience in a high-paced environment is a benefit.

- Prior SaaS implementation experience

- Procurement experience (procurement, sourcing, or vendor management background) and familiarity with procurement technologies such as ERP (Netsuite, Coupa, etc.), HRIS (Workday etc.), CLM, GRC, JIRA, ServiceNow workflow management tools.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to establish quick rapport and trust with customers.

- Strong project management skills to manage a dynamic customer portfolio.

- Creative problem solver while being attentive to details.

- Business process-oriented and ability to think about workflow efficiency (e.g. diagrams, conditionally based logic, etc.).

title: Senior Events Manager
description:

SentiLink supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in-office. We operate as a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India. We maintain physical offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India. If you’re located near one of these offices, we would love for you to spend time in the office regularly. Some roles are hybrid or in-office by design. For example, our engineering team in India works primarily from our Gurugram office.

ROLE:

As a Senior Events Manager at SentiLink, you will own and execute high-impact events and field marketing programs that drive pipeline and deepen relationships with our target customers. This includes leading SentiLink’s presence at key industry conferences as well as designing and executing targeted roadshows in priority markets.

You’ll play a critical role in building our presence in the fraud, identity, and financial services ecosystem-through industry events, hosted experiences, and partner activations.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution: equally comfortable planning a multi-city roadshow as you are rolling up your sleeves onsite to ensure flawless delivery. We’re looking for someone who is energized by the opportunity to contribute to a growing team and help collaborate to shape the future of our events program.

This is a remote, US-based role.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the strategy and execution of SentiLink’s field marketing and events program, including industry conferences, hosted events, partner activations, and regional roadshows

- Plan and execute multi-city roadshows in key markets, including venue selection, audience targeting, partner coordination, and local promotion

- Partner closely with Sales to identify priority accounts and regions, driving attendance and meeting generation for roadshows and events

- Manage end-to-end event execution: vendor coordination, logistics, booth strategy, content, and onsite execution

- Drive measurable pipeline impact from events and roadshows, including pre-event outreach, onsite engagement, and post-event conversion

- Develop creative, differentiated event experiences that reinforce SentiLink’s brand and thought leadership

- Collaborate with Product Marketing and Growth teams to ensure consistent messaging and campaign alignment across channel

We are running a paid study evaluating how customer service teams utilize Salesforce Marketing Cloud in their daily operations. title: Software Engineer
description:
Most machine learning systems stop learning the moment they ship. We build the Continuous Learning System (CLS), continuous AI: an architecture that learns during live operation. It ingests streaming data through a mesh of distributed actors and adapts to structural change without a retraining cycle, running entirely on ordinary CPUs. The CLS runs today in ongoing projects with partners across several industries and use cases, and we are funded.
We are a small, senior team. This role exists because the system works and the world around it now needs to be built.
Tasks

Product. Build and own our customer-facing surface: dashboards, APIs, account and access management, the interfaces through which customers meet the CLS.
Data platform. Pipelines on Dagster, time-series storage in QuestDB, and ingestion from the real world in all its mess: industrial CSV exports, biosignal formats such as EEG, EMG, and IMU, and public APIs of famously variable reliability, ENTSO-E being the canonical example.
Live operations. Keep our partner deployments observable and reliable, and make incidents boring.
Tooling. Build the internal tools that let a team of six move like a team of twenty.
Growth path. As you learn the system, work your way into the CLS core itself: the distributed runtime and the engineering of a system that never stops learning. We will actively support that path.

Requirements

A computer science degree, ideally an MSc, and roughly two to six years of hands-on software development. An outstanding recent MSc with substantial real project work also qualifies.
Production experience in at least one modern stack. Our codebase is Python; if yours was Java, Kotlin, or TypeScript, we expect you to become excellent in Python quickly, and we have seen strong engineers do exactly that.

title: Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing
description:
ABOUT OSCILAR

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platform™ for banks and fintechs-reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance, and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data, and AI agents together in a single system, enabling risk teams to make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex workflows.

Today, Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, from fast-growing fintechs to some of the largest financial institutions in the world, such as SoFi, MoneyGram, and Nuvei. We are rapidly expanding across fraud, credit, AML, onboarding, and risk decisioning.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, and is backed by world-class investors.

We believe AI will fundamentally reshape financial infrastructure-and Oscilar has the opportunity to define the category at the center of that transformation.

We are building a category-defining company, and our brand will be one of our greatest competitive advantages.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing to lead Brand, PR, and Communications and help make Oscilar one of the most recognized and respected brands in financial technology.

You’ll start as a player-coach: setting the strategy and direction for the function while staying deeply hands-on in building and launching the programs that establish Oscilar as a category-defining brand. As the company scales, you’ll build and lead the team responsible for Brand, PR, and Communications.

This is not a traditional brand strategy role. We’re looking for a builder and leader-someone who can develop a bold point of view, turn ideas into programs quickly, leverage AI to dramatically increase the team’s output, and find creative ways to put Oscilar at the center of industry conversations.

You’ll own how Oscilar shows up in the market across brand strategy, PR and communications, executive thought leadership, flagship brand programs, industry partnerships, and creative campaigns.

You’ll also lead our external agency partners and establish the systems, operating rhythms, and playbooks that allow the function to scale.

This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on company growth and reputation.

You will report directly to our VP of Marketing and Growth and work closely with our CEO and executive team, as well as Product Marketing, Growth, Events, and Design.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD

You will create and scale the programs that establish Oscilar as the leading brand in AI-powered risk decisioning.

Brand Strategy & Programs

- Define how Oscilar builds awareness, credibility, and category leadership as we scale.

- Build flagship programs that put Oscilar at the center of conversations shaping the future of risk and financial services.

- Develop industry awards, executive communities, original research, customer advocacy, and other differentiated brand properties.

- Create signature programs that become recognized and anticipated across the industry.

- Turn successful initiatives into repeatable programs that compound over time.

 

PR & Communications

- Own Oscilar’s PR and communications strategy in partnership with internal resources and external agencies.

- Build relationships with influential media, analysts, industry organizations, and other voices shaping our market.

- Develop compelling narratives around company announcements, product launches, customer stories, company milestones, and category trends.

- Build a consistent drumbeat of stories that strengthens Oscilar’s reputation and market position.

- Identify proactive opportunities to insert Oscilar and our executives into important industry conversations.

- Lead and hold our external PR partners accountable for results.

 

Executive Thought Leadership

- Build programs that establish Oscilar’s executives and subject matter experts as defining voices in the industry.

title: Field Marketing Manager - DACH
description:
Description
WHO WE ARE
Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera ’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. In this role, you’ll develop and execute integrated, multi-touch programmes including events, digital campaigns, and partner co-marketing initiatives. You’ll gain first-hand experience in how a fast-growing company builds a world-class brand across the EMEA region, executing field and channel marketing programmes that directly support our sales and partner ecosystem in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.
The ideal candidate is both a team player and a self-starter - someone who is hands-on, relationship-driven, and passionate about taking projects from concept to flawless execution, with a strong feel for the nuances of the DACH market.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Work closely with sales leadership and partner teams to ensure marketing initiatives align with territory plans, sales objectives, and pipeline goals.

Collaboration & Measurement:

• Partner with sales and business development teams to ensure lead follow-up, tracking, and conversion are optimised.

• Measure and report on field and channel marketing performance, tracking key metrics such as engagement, conversion, velocity, and ROI.

Content & Messaging:

• Adapt and localise global messaging for regional relevance, ensuring it resonates with DACH audiences - including German-language adaptation where appropriate.

• Contribute to the creation of compelling campaign copy, partner assets, and digital marketing content.

Requirements
REQUIRED BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of five (5) years experience delivering enterprise Field Marketing and channel marketing excellence

• Fluency in German and English (written and spoken); additional DACH market knowledge is a strong advantage

• Highly knowledgeable about demand generation and marketing best practices

• Results-oriented with a passion for performance measurement and analytics

• Experience delivering engagement programs that ensure incredibly successful customers who continue to renew

title: Risk Strategist
description:
Who we are

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and pursue new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet. We have significant work ahead, which gives you the opportunity to do important work that expands access to the global economy.

About the team

The APAC Risk team helps Stripe launch and grow products responsibly. We work closely with global Product, Partnerships, and Risk teams to identify product risks early, define practical controls, and make risk decisions easier to execute at scale.

What you’ll do

As a Risk Strategist, you will help Stripe launch new Local Payment Methods (LPMs) and other products safely as part of our broader global expansion efforts. You will be part of a team that identifies, assesses, and manages risk across LPMs and other product launches. Your focus will be on building agent-based workflows that help scale LPM launches and related risk assessments across cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

• Identify risk scenarios associated with new products, product changes, and LPM initiatives. Translate those scenarios into clear requirements, controls, and actions for different cross-functional teams

• Improve and automate product-risk workflows through AI tools, data, and agent-based solutions. Define and build consistent, scalable processes with reduced manual load

• Help set the risk strategy and operating approach for product launches, including how teams assess risk, record decisions, and monitor outcomes

• Communicate complex risk issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, with practical recommendations that support responsible product growth

• Help define metrics that track risk exposure, control effectiveness, and operational efficiency

• Build strong working relationships across Risk and Product, and help align teams when trade-offs or ambiguity arise

• Develop expertise that can support adjacent product-risk areas over time, including fraud

Who you are

You are comfortable working in ambiguous spaces where products, risks, and processes are still being defined. You can reason through risk scenarios, bring structure to complex questions, and work with technical partners to turn recommendations into scalable solutions.

You are also motivated by improving how work gets done. You do not only identify risks. You look for ways to make risk assessment, decision-making, and monitoring more automated, consistent, and useful for the teams building Stripe products.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of experience in risk, financial services, fintech, product strategy, data, or a related field

• Experience partnering with cross-functional teams, especially Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, or Partnerships

• Strong analytical judgment and the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and next steps

• Familiarity with and a keen interest in building and applying automation, tools, or agent-based workflows to improve processes and outcomes

• Experience using data to investigate problems, assess performance, or inform decisions

• Ability to communicate clearly with a range of stakeholders and build alignment across teams with different priorities

Preferred qualifications

• Experience assessing risk for new products, product launches, or material product changes

• Experience in payments, product risk, platform risk, fraud, or financial crimes

• Experience using and building agentic workflows and using AI tools to simplify processes

• Experience with SQL, data analysis, data science workflows, or building operational tools

• Experience working with technical teams to define requirements and improve internal systems or processes

• Familiarity with risk-control design, monitoring, or policy development

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

SENIOR FULLSTACK ENGINEER UK

Full-time /London (Engineering)

About Applied Intuition Defence

Applied Intuition UK is a software and infrastructure supplier that accelerates the deployment of next-generation autonomous capabilities to the warfighter across air, land, sea, and space. A subsidiary of Applied Intuition, we deliver dual-use solutions to national security customers that build upon several years of product development and experience from commercial autonomy programs. Learn more at appliedintuitiondefense.com http://appliedintuitiondefense.com.

You would be the first fullstack engineer we hire onto the UK team, joining software and autonomy engineers whose tools are already relied on across live programmes. As that portfolio grows, we are bringing in dedicated fullstack expertise to shape how the user-facing products we ship are designed and built. Every day is different: designing an interface around how a customer actually operates, building the services and APIs behind it, working with our design team so what we ship in London is coherent with everything else Applied Intuition builds, or taking what we learn on a programme and landing it in the products of the teams we work alongside. You will move between languages and layers as the problem demands, and you will have a strong voice in how these products get built. You bring the judgement of a career spent shipping production software, and you watch the people you built it for take it into the field.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Take new products from concept through to production at the pace our programmes demand, owning the technical and product decisions along the way

- Build features end to end, from the interface through the API to the services and data behind it

- Set the front-end foundations for our UK products: shared components, sensible patterns, and a design language consistent with the rest of the company

- Decide, with the team, when a new capability should stand alone and when it belongs in our core product offering

- Get the improvements we identify on programmes into the products our other teams build, so what we learn in the field shapes the wider roadmap

- Engineer security in from the first commit, and build software that holds up to the environments and the scrutiny our customers operate under

- Help raise the bar for how user-facing software is built here, and build products people depend on and that you are proud of

description:
As Senior Product Manager in the Regulatory Group at Flinn, you'll be owning a product at a major inflection point. It has a deep data foundation, a task-based workflow that saves regulatory experts time, and a growing base of enterprise customers. Your job is to take our regulatory product from early traction to enterprise-ready: benchmarking what's working, closing workflow gaps that matter to highly specialized users, and finding the improvement vectors that could change how regulatory teams work. The path there is earned through sharp prioritization, close customer proximity, and the ability to turn complex problems into concrete steps.

WHY FLINN?

- We are building a truly exceptional culture: While many companies claim to have a great culture, we invite you to discover what truly sets ours apart. Visit our career page https://www.notion.so/Flinn-Career-Page-80b35dece226477c8ab234c0573b42e9?pvs=21, speak with our team, listen to our founders’ podcast, or experience our culture first-hand during the interview process.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

- Join a fast-growing, well-funded European startup backed by experienced founders and investors.

- Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives.

- Take end-to-end ownership of core operational processes that keep the company running.

- Play a key role in scaling Flinn, shaping how operations work as we grow.

- Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership.

- Enjoy flexible working hours, remote flexibility, and regular team time in Vienna.

- Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates.

- Receive one of the most employee-friendly equity packages, including fair vesting terms and profit-sharing opportunities.

- Grow in a professional, high-standard environment that supports long-term personal and career development.

YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS TO OUR JOURNEY:

- Own the Regulatory product roadmap and take the product to one that enterprise customers genuinely rely on at scale.

- Stay close to customers. Understand the day-to-day workflow of regulatory experts well enough to know which friction points are worth solving and which are noise.

- Identify and prioritize incremental improvements that reduce real workflow friction, while keeping a longer view on where the product could create entirely new ways of working for your users.

- Work tightly with engineering and customer success to move ideas from discovery to shipped and adopted

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

- Experience building complex products from the ground up

- Strong ability and openness to operate at both strategic and execution levels, and to switch between them effortlessly.

- High curiosity and hands-on interest in AI-first products.

- Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience under pressure, a strong sense of ownership, and a bias toward action and learning.

- Excellent communication skills (fluent in verbal and written English; German is a plus).

ATTRIBUTES WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- 3+ years of experience in Product Management.

- Proven experience taking a B2B product from early traction to scaled adoption.

- Experience working on workflow-heavy or domain-specialist tools (regulatory, legal, compliance, finance).

- Demonstrable ability to break complex problems into structured, executable steps.

- Strong personal organization skills enabling you to own your workload without a need for process scaffolding.

- Comfortable working in ambiguity with limited resourcing.

You'll set Radiant's safety and quality standard and get on planes to sites to apply it yourself, this isn't a policy-writing role, it's a be-on-site, catch-the-problem-before-it-happens role, at least until the team grows. You'll also embed health and safety requirements into outgoing RFPs and contractor responses.

Key Responsibilities

Standards

- Write Radiant's EHS and quality standards and inspection/ITP methodology from scratch.

- Personally audit sites and contractor safety performance, not just review reports.

Incident management

- Run incident investigation and lessons-learned directly in the early stages.

Team build

- Recruit regional EHS managers as the portfolio grows, while continuing to be hands-on at site level yourself.

- Expect to hire a Document Controller as document volume grows into the thousands - not needed from day one.

What You Bring:

- Hands-on EHS or quality management experience on construction or industrial sites, ideally data centres or similarly complex builds.

- Comfort travelling to sites regularly and getting into the detail yourself.

- A standard-setter's mindset; you'll be helping in writing the rulebook, not just enforcing someone else's.

- We value a safety-first instinct and hands-on attitude over a specific certification.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

- NEBOSH or equivalent EHS qualification.

- Experience across both European and US health & safety regulatory regimes.

- Quality management (ISO 9001 or similar) experience.

Qualities we look for:

- Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

- Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change.

- You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

- Get stuck in: You'd rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you - attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

title: Deposition Transcript Attorney (CA Licensed - Remote)
description:
Position Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented Depo Transcript Attorney to join our Workers' Compensation practice. This attorney will focus exclusively on the review of deposition transcripts in partnership with clients following each deposition - this role does not take or defend depositions. Instead, the attorney reviews the completed transcript and case file, discusses findings and next steps directly with the client, updates the file with any new information developed, and then moves on to the next deposition in the queue.
This is a high-volume, single-focus role ideal for an attorney who thrives on consistent process, clear client communication, and accurate timekeeping.
Key Responsibilities
Transcript & File Review

• Review deposition transcripts in detail upon completion of each deposition, identifying key testimony, discrepancies, and issues relevant to the case.

• Cross-reference transcript content against the existing case file, medical records, and prior discovery to ensure the file reflects the most current and accurate information.

• Update the case file promptly with any new facts, admissions, or developments uncovered during the deposition.

Client Discussion & Communication

• Conduct post-deposition discussions with clients to walk through the transcript, explain its significance, and answer questions.

• Communicate next steps and any impact on case strategy or value in clear, accessible terms.

• Serve as a consistent, reliable point of contact for clients during the post-deposition phase of their case.

Caseload & Time Management

• Move efficiently from one completed deposition to the next, maintaining a steady, high-volume review queue.

• Accurately track and enter billable time for all file review and client discussion activity in accordance with firm billing practices.

• Flag any cases requiring escalation to the assigned trial attorney or additional legal team members.

Required

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school.

• Active member of the California State Bar, in good standing.

• Strong knowledge of California workers' compensation law and deposition procedure.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal information to clients in plain terms.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of files.

• Accurate and timely billing/time-entry habits.

Preferred

• Prior experience reviewing depositions or transcripts in a workers' compensation or civil litigation practice preferred but not required.

• Experience with client-facing case discussions.

• Familiarity with ALG internal case management and billing systems (or ability to learn quickly).

Benefits
Our law firm offers eligible employees a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage. We also provide eligible employees with flexible time off plans, including Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO), and paid holidays.

title: Senior Security Solutions Engineer
description:
Ever been the person everyone Slacks who either has the answer, or knows how to track it down? That’s this job. As a Senior Security Solutions Engineer, you’re the technical brain trust behind Expel ’s Customer Success team - the “the buck stops here” expert who makes sure our CSMs, TAMs, and support engineers always have a fast, accurate answer to bring to customers.
When a customer question gets thorny, it lands with you. You untangle it, you document it so it’s answered even faster next time, and you keep the rest of Expel focused on the work only they can do. If you love being deep in security tech and equally love making other people better at their jobs, keep reading.
What Expel can do for you

• Give you broad exposure to the technology, architecture, integrations, and security operations behind an MDR platform

• Put you close to customers and the technical problems security teams are solving every day

• Give you the opportunity to become a trusted technical resource across Customer Success, Security, Detection & Response, and Engineering

• Let you solve complex technical problems while also building documentation and processes that make the entire organization more effective

• Surround you with curious security practitioners who genuinely enjoy sharing what they know

• Give you room to mentor others, sharpen your own technical depth, and continuously improve how we support our customers

What you can do for Expel

• Be the go-to escalation point for CS - responding quickly and accurately to ad-hoc technical questions from CSMs, TAMs, and TSEs so no one’s left waiting.

• Hop on customer calls when the moment calls for deep technical expertise, backing up the CSM or TAM who owns the relationship.

• Hunt down knowledge gaps and turn them into great documentation - authoring, reviewing, and continuously sharpening technical and process content.

• Partner with teams across Security, Detection & Response, and Engineering to pull knowledge into the team and operationalize it.

• Curate internal and external knowledge repositories and point people to self-service answers when that’s the faster path.

• Enable other teams - especially CSM, TAM, and Technical Support - so the flood of inbound questions gets smaller over time.

• Coach and mentor less experienced teammates, and keep clean records of inquiry volume so the team can prioritize what matters.

What you should bring with you
You’ve spent 7+ years in security, at least half of it in a technical, customer-facing role - ideally consultative. You’ve got real depth across three or more security product spaces (EDR, NDR, SIEM, cloud, you name it) and you can reason about the tradeoffs teams make in security operations. Just as important: you’re a genuinely good communicator who can shift from talking shop with a practitioner to briefing a customer’s senior leadership without missing a beat.
You’ll thrive here if you bring:

• Sharp root-cause analysis and troubleshooting - you diagnose complex technical issues completely and accurately.

• A firm grasp of the cybersecurity market: the products, the providers, and their real strengths and weaknesses.

• Fluency in security controls across Windows, Unix/Linux, AWS, GSuite, O365, and network gear.

• A solid handle on attack vectors, threat tactics, attacker techniques (think ATT&CK), and the attack lifecycle.

• Strong consultative instincts - active listening, conflict management, negotiation, and knowing when (and how gracefully) to escalate.

• An intrinsic drive to self-assess and keep getting better.

A bachelor’s degree and/or relevant certifications are a plus, but we care more about what you can do than where you learned it.
Additional notes
The base salary range for this role is between $122,400 USD and $177,500 USD + variable eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $145,000 and $165,000 based on experience,

What you can expect
In this role, you'll support the operations, adoption, and continuous improvement of Zoom's connected planning ecosystem. You'll work across use cases and business domains, adapting to where the need is greatest. As well as serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders and the technical team. This is a support and program management function designed for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can flex across priorities.

About the Team
Zoom's Enterprise Apps team builds and supports the connected planning systems that power decision-making across our business. We partner with Finance, Go-To-Market, and People Experience teams to deliver scalable, reliable planning solutions. We're looking for someone who can help us do that better, faster, and more consistently as we grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build & ship APIs: Build and ship REST/GraphQL APIs that power real workflows used by Fortune 500 companies.

- Write production-ready code: Write clean, tested, production-ready code, not just prototypes.

- Own issues end-to-end: Debug and own issues from the database query to the API response.

- Design data models: Work directly with product and frontend engineers to design data models and contracts.

- Review & own: Participate in code reviews, giving, not just receiving, feedback, and gradually own a service or subsystem sooner than you'd think.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Strong fundamentals: Data structures, algorithms, system design basics, and databases.

- Backend language: Proficiency in at least one backend language: Python, Node.js, Go, or Java.

- Real project experience: You've built something real (a side project, open-source contribution, or hackathon win) touching several of: a relational database (schema design, queries, indexes), authentication (JWT, sessions, OAuth, implemented, not just read about), a cache layer (Redis or similar), an API with real error handling (400s, 401s, 500s, not just 200s), a message queue or background job (Kafka, SQS, Celery, or a simple cron), and deploying something beyond localhost http://localhost (Docker, a cloud VM, or a serverless function).

- Web fundamentals: You understand how the internet works: HTTP, REST, auth, caching, beyond a textbook level.

- Curiosity: You ask "why" before you ask "how," and you're the kind of person who reads documentation for fun.

- AI-assisted building: You use AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, or LLM APIs) in your workflow: prompting well, spotting hallucinations, and never blindly trusting generated code.

description:
Wer wir sind

NEXUS gehört zu den führenden europäischen Anbietern von Softwarelösungen für Krankenhäuser, Reha-Einrichtungen und das Sozialwesen.

Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Krankenhausinformationssystem (KIS), mit dem wir Kliniken bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Kernprozesse unterstützen.

Mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden gestalten wir die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens - gemeinsam, innovativ und mit Leidenschaft.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine/n

Gruppenleitung Projektmanagement (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt Krankenhausinformationssystem (KIS)

Standort: Donaueschingen, Ismaning, Frankfurt am Main, Jena, Berlin

Gestalte die Zukunft unseres Projektmanagements.

Bei NEXUS entwickeln Menschen mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen. Als einer der führenden europäischen Anbieter von eHealth-Lösungen unterstützen wir Krankenhäuser dabei, ihre Prozesse digital und effizient zu gestalten - damit Ärzt:innen und Pflegekräfte mehr Zeit für das Wesentliche haben: ihre Patient:innen.

Im Bereich Professional Services entsteht aktuell eine neue Führungsebene. Deshalb suchen wir zwei Gruppenleitungen, die nicht nur Menschen führen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns den Projektmanagementbereich der Zukunft aufbauen.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Teams weiterzuentwickeln, komplexe Projekte zu steuern und Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgabe

Als Gruppenleitung führst du ein Team von fünf bis zehn Projektleiter:innen und sorgst gemeinsam mit ihnen für den Erfolg unserer Kundenprojekte.

Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung in drei zentralen Bereichen:

Menschen führen

Du entwickelst dein Team fachlich und persönlich weiter, führst regelmäßige Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Projektleiter:innen erfolgreich arbeiten können. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du das Recruiting neuer Kolleg:innen und förderst den Wissenstransfer innerhalb deiner Gruppe.

Projekte steuern

Du behältst den Überblick über alle Projekte deiner Gruppe, erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und sorgst für die richtige Priorisierung von Ressourcen. Bei Eskalationen unterstützt du deine Projektleiter:innen und arbeitest eng mit Kunden sowie internen Fachbereichen zusammen.

Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr professionelle Standards und Methoden für unser Projektmanagement weiter und etabliert diese nachhaltig im Team.

Den Bereich weiterentwickeln

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer neuen Führungsebene aktiv mitzugestalten.

Zusammen mit den anderen Gruppenleitungen entwickelst du Prozesse, Methoden und Strukturen weiter und bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Projektalltag in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unseres Bereichs ein.

Wähle deinen Schwerpunkt

Wir besetzen zwei Gruppenleitungspositionen.

Schwerpunkt Neukundenprojekte

Du verantwortest Projekte zur Einführung unseres Krankenhausinformationssystems bei neuen Kunden. Diese Projekte zeichnen sich durch hohe Dynamik, viele Beteiligte und anspruchsvolle Projektphasen bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live aus.

Schwerpunkt Bestandskunden

Du verantwortest Projekte rund um Rollouts, Upgrades und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundeninstallationen. Hier stehen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, Veränderungsmanagement und nachhaltige Projektqualität im Mittelpunkt.

Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung an, welcher Schwerpunkt dich besonders interessiert. Selbstverständlich freuen wir uns auch über Bewerbungen, wenn beide Bereiche für dich spannend sind.

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement komplexer IT-Projekte

• Idealerweise Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder im Krankenhausumfeld

• Erste Führungserfahrung oder den Wunsch, den nächsten Schritt in eine Führungsrolle zu gehen

• Freude daran, Menschen zu entwickeln und Teams erfolgreich zu machen

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig

• Kommunikationsstärke, Entscheidungsfreude und Durchsetzungsvermögen

title: Sr. GRC Analyst
description:
Join Aya Healthcare , winner of multiple Top Workplace awards!
We are seeking a Senior Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) Analyst to help operate and mature Aya’s enterprise GRC program, with a strong emphasis on compliance automation, scalability, and operational excellence. In this role, you will own GRC projects and deliverables across the organization while serving as a subject-matter expert in compliance operations, risk management, and ServiceNow GRC / IRM.
This is a hands-on opportunity for someone energized by improving modern GRC capabilities and moving away from manual, point-in-time audit work toward automated, continuously operating compliance processes.
You will work cross-functionally across Information Security, IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, Finance, and Audit to translate regulatory and framework requirements into practical controls, improve evidence collection and reporting, and deliver clear, actionable insights to stakeholders and leadership.
You will work in the Security organization and report to the Manager, Governance, Risk & Compliance.
This role is remote and will work PST business hours.
Who We Are:
We’re an $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.
At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians, and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem-solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.
Responsibilities:

• Own assigned GRC projects, compliance deliverables, and process improvements from planning through completion.

• Support the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of Aya’s enterprise GRC program.

• Design and improve scalable workflows that translate regulatory and framework requirements into clear control activities and operational responsibilities.

• Support compliance efforts for SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022, including readiness activities, audit preparation, evidence coordination, control testing, auditor support, and remediation tracking.

• Establish and maintain clear control ownership, traceability, documentation, and evidence requirements.

• Identify opportunities to replace manual or spreadsheet-driven compliance activities with automated, system-driven processes.

• Improve automated evidence collection, control testing, issue and remediation tracking, dashboards, and reporting.

• Conduct control reviews, risk assessments, evidence evaluations, and compliance gap analyses.

• Monitor remediation activities, follow up with control owners, identify delivery risks, and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Build and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that communicate compliance status, trends, exceptions, risks, and remediation progress.

• Partner with ServiceNow platform and engineering teams to ensure GRC solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise processes.

• Engage with customers to respond to compliance, security, privacy, and risk-related questions in RFPs, due diligence requests, contracts, and customer meetings.

• Collaborate with Security, IT, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Privacy, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders to resolve control and compliance issues.

title: Director, Forensic Geotechnical Consulting
description:
HKA is a global leader in risk mitigation, dispute resolution, and expert witness services. We tackle complex challenges with our multi-disciplinary expertise.

As trusted consultants and advisors, we deliver solutions in uncertain and disputed situations, ensuring the best outcomes for clients worldwide. Our experts have testified globally on major cases spanning across a wide range of industries and sectors.
As part of the HKA team you can expect:

• Exposure to complex, high-value disputes involving transportation, infrastructure, energy, tunneling, dams, airports, and other major construction projects.

• Mentorship from nationally recognized geotechnical and forensic engineering experts with experience serving as technical and testifying experts in litigation and arbitration matters.

• The opportunity to develop expertise in forensic engineering, expert witness consulting, and dispute resolution while working on some of the industry's most challenging technical investigations.

The Opportunity
HKA is seeking an experienced Geotechnical Engineer to support forensic investigations, develop technical opinions, prepare expert reports, and assist with complex claims, arbitration, and litigation matters. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-profile disputes involving major transportation, infrastructure, energy, water, underground construction, and heavy civil projects throughout North America and internationally.
Working alongside nationally recognized experts, you will investigate complex geotechnical and construction issues involving differing site conditions, foundations, earthwork, slope stability, groundwater, retaining structures, and standard of care matters while building expertise in forensic engineering and dispute resolution.
Responsibilities

• Conduct forensic investigations involving geotechnical, geologic, civil, and construction-related issues.
